goal: To facilitate private messaging between users while allowing all messages to be publicly searchable.
main_components: Database for storing messages and user data
User Interface for messaging and searching
assumptions: Message content will be stored in a publicly accessible format for searchability.
Registered users must authenticate to send messages, but messages can be searched without authentication.
Users need not be notified about their messages being publicly searchable.
open_questions: How to protect user privacy while allowing messages to be searchable?
Should there be any restrictions on who can search the messages?
Will users have any control over the visibility of their messages?
